variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished full-screen portrait mobile game concept, aspect ratio 390:845 (about 0.462), complete screen edge to edge, no phone bezel, no concept labels. It is the Vietnamese "Thu nhập ngoại tuyến" Offline Income popup for a Godot idle racing game. Use the reference images as style and content references: approved 01-race.png and 06-shop.png establish the Soft Miniature art direction; offline_390_capped.png establishes the exact current content and bottom navigation; offline_income_art.png is the hero garage design to preserve.
Style: premium soft 3D miniature toy diorama UI, bright sky-blue, ivory cream, vivid orange, gold, deep navy rounded bold Vietnamese typography. Beveled curved surfaces, soft ambient occlusion, plush edge highlights, controlled gloss, substantial tactile depth. Match approved pack, NOT flat generic stacked rectangles. All popup text readable at 390 logical pixels. Strongly separate title / income / action blocks with silhouette, spacing, depth, and material changes.
Background: dimmed race game screen with header resources, miniature circuit and tiny cars, upgrade rows beneath; dark translucent navy modal scrim over background including bottom bar. Bottom tab bar five icons and these exact labels LEFT TO RIGHT: "Shop", "Túi", "Đua", "Đội", "Giải". Center Đua tab selected. Race screen remains recognizable but popup dominates. Popup approximately 350 logical px wide centered within screen, ample margins top/bottom.
Hero illustration: preserve offline_income_art design: small cream garage with curved bright blue roof and blue trim, gray roll-up door, wrench medallion, blue/yellow racing car at left, large gold-rim analog clock near roof at right, gold coin stacks and green cash bundles at right, tiny greenery and warm office window. Keep art dimensional and crisp.
Exact popup content, each ONCE and no extra popup copy: title "Thu nhập ngoại tuyến"; reward "+28,8K" next to a chunky green cash bundle icon; full time bar "Đã đầy · 120/120 phút"; ONE wide primary ORANGE button "Tiếp tục". Proper Vietnamese accents and correct comma. Time bar must visually be full. No close button, no secondary action, no ads, no tiny helper text. Reward is the strongest numeric focal point.

Variant A — Overlapping ribbon / inset window / separate footer. Cream softly rounded main modal with blue outer edge. A sculpted bright blue ribbon banner with short folded tails overlaps the modal's TOP edge; title in large ivory white on the ribbon, allowed two centered lines if needed. Main income block is a recessed sky-blue diorama window with thick cream bevel; the garage, gold clock and coins physically break out over the inset frame, giving charming depth. Below illustration INSIDE that income block a large cream/gold reward area with green cash icon and "+28,8K". Full gold time bar below, clearly secondary. A distinct softly curved light-blue footer strip with a visible seam and shadow supports the wide orange "Tiếp tục" button. Ribbon, recessed income window, footer must read as three deliberately different shapes, not repeated rectangles.

Variant B — Tall glossy-soft hero card / overlapping reward medallion. A single elegant tall cream hero card, soft blue beveled perimeter. Large garage illustration dominates a sky-blue rounded dome in upper half; clock and roof project outside its curved outline. Middle income composition is a miniature garage diorama on a thick cream oval display plinth, set slightly to LEFT; roof and large gold clock break above the plinth. On RIGHT LOWER FRONT of the illustration place a LARGE raised gold-edged cream near-circular capsule with green cash icon and huge navy "+28,8K" so the reward feels like a dimensional hanging shop sign, never obscures garage clock or car. Shape variety, tasteful overlap and miniature depth; still simple and legible.
